gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Visit us to walk along our boardwalk of our early town and look through the interior of buildings and stores, preserved as they once were. Then take a trip forward to the beginning of the electric era. Don't forget to check out our vast display of antique cars, the Safari Exhibit or weather permitting - Mini Golf.
